## County Information

### Description

Greenup County was named for Christopher Greenup. The county is located in the northeastern area of the state.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### County Courthouse

**Greenup County Courthouse**  
Main & Harrison  
Greenup, KY 41144-1055  
Phone: 606-473-7394[[3]](#cite_note-3)  
[Greenup County Website](https://www.greenupcountyky.gov/)
